definitions.gloss: personal belongings; private property; personal effects
definitions.explanation: Items that belong to an individual personally, as opposed to shared or organizational property. Often used in workplace and institutional settings.

examples.japanese: {私物|しぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}って→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take your personal belongings with you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{私物|しぶつ}{化|か}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not treat company computers as personal property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私物|しぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you leave the company, please clear all personal items from your desk.

notes:
USAGE:
{私物|しぶつ} is commonly used in workplaces, schools, and shared spaces to distinguish personal items from organizational property.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私物|しぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧ (to bring personal items in)
- {私物|しぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}る→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧ (to take personal items home)
- {私物|しぶつ}{化|か}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appropriate something as personal property)
- {私物|しぶつ}⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (personal items not allowed)
